name: Typography
description: Reading. Reading text stays 16px/24px on every platform, and text scaling always takes precedence over layout.

components.name: Title
components.anatomy: A heading at one of six levels, with tightened tracking at display sizes.
components.geometry: 1.2 line height; -0.04em tracking; sizes on a modular scale
components.semantics: The visual level must not be chosen independently of the document outline; use a level, style separately

components.name: Text
components.anatomy: Body copy with size, weight, colour role and truncation options.
components.semantics: Truncated text keeps its full value in the accessibility tree and in a title where useful

components.name: Blockquote
components.anatomy: Quoted content with a leading rule and optional attribution.
components.semantics: Real blockquote with cite where the source is known

components.name: Mark
components.anatomy: Inline highlighted text, typically a search match.
components.material: Primary-soft fill with its tested ink pair
components.geometry: 4px radius; does not disturb the line box
components.semantics: Real mark element; highlighting is never the only indication of a match

components.name: Prose
components.anatomy: Long-form content with consistent rhythm across headings, lists, tables, code and media.
components.material: Inherits; embedded surfaces follow their own components
components.semantics: Anchor navigation must preserve focus when sections change
components.crystal: The complete reading rhythm and embedded-element treatment

components.name: Highlight
components.anatomy: Marks matching substrings inside a run of text.
components.material: Haze fill behind the matched run
components.geometry: Fill hugs the text; no radius change at line breaks.
components.semantics: Uses <mark>; the surrounding sentence remains readable as one string.
components.crystal: Fill material, contrast against the surface

components.name: Number formatter
components.anatomy: Renders a number under a locale and unit.
components.semantics: The formatted value is the text content; no separate visual and spoken form.

components.name: Display
components.anatomy: The largest type step, for a single statement per view.
components.geometry: Tightest tracking of the scale; one line where possible.
components.semantics: Exactly one per view, and it is the h1 unless the page says otherwise.

components.name: Heading
components.anatomy: Section headings, levels two to six.
components.geometry: Step per level; leading tightens as size grows.
components.semantics: The level is the document structure, never chosen for size — size comes from the step.

components.name: Lead
components.anatomy: The standfirst paragraph beneath a title.
components.geometry: One step above body; measure capped for reading.

components.name: Prose list
components.anatomy: Ordered and unordered lists inside running text, with Crystal markers.
components.geometry: Marker inset follows the spacing scale; hanging indent preserved.
components.semantics: Real ul and ol so the count and nesting are announced.

components.name: Code block
components.anatomy: A multi-line code sample with optional highlighting.
components.material: Haze fill with a crisp monospace face
components.geometry: Content radius; the copy control is a pill.
components.semantics: Focusable and scrollable by keyboard; the language is announced; the copy button says what it copied.
components.crystal: Fill material, the monospace pairing, copy feedback motion

components.name: Truncate
components.anatomy: Clamps text to a line count with an accessible full value.
components.geometry: Clamp by line count, never by pixel height.
components.semantics: The full text remains available to assistive technology; expansion is a real control.
components.crystal: The fade, if any, and the expand motion

components.name: Cite
components.anatomy: An attribution attached to a quotation.
components.geometry: Sits beneath the quote at one step down.
components.semantics: Uses cite, and is associated with its blockquote.

components.name: Abbreviation
components.anatomy: An abbreviation with its expansion available.
components.geometry: No visual weight change; underline on hover only.
components.semantics: Uses abbr with a title, and is focusable so the expansion is reachable without a pointer.

components.name: Balanced text
components.anatomy: Headings wrapped so lines are even rather than ragged.
components.geometry: Balances wrapping without changing the step.
components.semantics: Purely visual: the text content is unchanged.
components.crystal: Where balancing applies, and its fallback

components.name: Gradient text
components.anatomy: Text filled with a palette gradient.
components.material: Palette gradient clipped to the glyphs
components.geometry: No change to step or tracking.
components.semantics: Contrast is checked against the surface at both gradient ends, and a solid fallback applies where the clip is unsupported.
components.crystal: The gradient, and the contrast floor at every point
